sources.title: L’unicorno Satispay raccoglie altri €60 milioni
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Announces a completed EUR 60m capital increase, supported by Addition, Greyhound and Lightrock; describes mobile payments and a Milan company base. URL slug is unrelated to the displayed funding title.

sources.title: 10 anni di Satispay: nuova identità per il circuito nato per disegnare il futuro dei pagamenti
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Footnote explicitly separates company founding in 2013 from app launch in 2015; names Milan headquarters.

sources.title: Satispay: capital increase of up to €120 million to accelerate its growth strategy in financial services
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Momentum S.p.A. is named as holding company; up to EUR 120m increase is proposed for shareholder approval, with approximately half backed by commitments from Greyhound, Addition and Lightrock. Boilerplate says founded in 2015.

sources.title: Satispay accelerates with Claude
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Identifies Dario Brignone as co-founder and Chief Innovation Officer. Footer identifies Luxembourg-registered payment/investment entities separately from the Milan welfare entity.

sources.title: Newsroom legal footer
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Satispay Europe S.A. and Satispay Invest S.A. have Luxembourg registered offices; SatisWelfare S.p.A. has a Milan registered office. These do not by themselves establish group HQ or incorporation date.

sources.title: About Us — Scalapay Careers
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Timeline identifies January 2019 founding by Simone Mancini and Johnny Mitrevski. Its Series B timeline month conflicts with the dated company announcement.

sources.title: Scalapay, now a unicorn, raises $497M Series B and enters the checkout market
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Company-issued announcement: USD 497m Series B, co-led by Tencent and Willoughby Capital; names five other participants. Refers to Mancini and Mitrevski as founders and separately to three founding-team members.

sources.title: Leading BNPL Platform Scalapay Raises $27M USD From Poste Italiane
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Company states USD 27m Series B extension from Poste Italiane; explicitly calls the February Series B USD 497m, resolving currency symbol ambiguity.

sources.title: Scalapay Partners with Trustfull to Strengthen BNPL Fraud Prevention across Europe
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Company-hosted partnership release dated 10 December 2024 states Scalapay is headquartered in Milan. Page publication is 16 January 2025.

sources.title: Scalapay IP terms and conditions version 2
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Terms distinguish Scalapay S.r.l., Scalapay IP S.p.A. and controlling Scalapay Limited; Italian subsidiaries have Milan registered offices.

sources.title: Casavo raises €400 million
sources.evidence_paraphrase: EUR 100m Series D equity is separate from up to EUR 300m debt capacity. Names Exor lead and specific equity participants. Giorgio Tinacci is founder and CEO.

sources.title: Casavo: €20 million round led by UniCredit
sources.evidence_paraphrase: EUR 20m capital raising closed in March 2024 as an extension of Series D, led by UniCredit, with Exor NV, Project A Ventures, Neva SGR and 360 Capital.
notes: Page date 6/8/2024 retained as ambiguous display; no precise announcement day asserted.

sources.title: Casavo inaugurates its new Milan office, to continue growing
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Narrative explicitly says Casavo began in October 2017 in Milan and describes Milan headquarters.

sources.title: Casavo acquires Casando Agency, doubling its agent network in Italy
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Capital increase exceeds EUR 12m; named supporters include Project A, Picus Capital, EVRG 18 and Salica Investments. The announcement links financing to an acquisition; purchase price is not given.

sources.title: Qomodo raises €13.5M Series A
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Milan-based Qomodo founded in 2023 by Gianluca Cocco and Gaetano de Maio. EUR 13.5m Series A co-led by RTP Global and LMDV Capital; Proximity and Primo participate. Earlier EUR 34.5m pre-seed includes debt; not treated as all equity.

sources.title: Qomodo
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Official payments website identifies Qomodo S.r.l., Milan company address and Italian VAT identity. Address label alone is not incorporation evidence.

sources.title: Fiscozen secures €3M Series A Round
sources.evidence_paraphrase: United Ventures leads EUR 3m Series A. Historical origin is late 2017, naming Fabio Ciotoli and Enrico Mattiazzi, supported by Vito Lomele; this differs from later founding accounts.

sources.title: Visma entra nel mercato italiano con un investimento strategico in Fiscozen
sources.publisher: Visma and Fiscozen via United Ventures
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Release states Fiscozen founded in Milan in 2018 and names co-founders Enrico Mattiazzi and Vito Lomele. Visma investment amount is undisclosed.

sources.title: Visma reaches EUR 2.5 billion in ARR after solid Q2
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Visma describes its April 2024 Fiscozen transaction as an acquisition.

sources.title: Fiscozen Privacy Policy
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Fiscozen S.p.A. registered and operational offices are in Milan; company is controlled by Visma International Holding AS.

sources.title: Jet HR: round da €25 mln per liberare le PMI italiane dalla burocrazia
sources.evidence_paraphrase: EUR 25m financing led by Base10; names founders Marco Ogliengo and Francesco Scalambrino and HR/payroll product. No named additional round participants in the release.

sources.title: Chi Siamo — Jet HR
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Timeline says founders formed Jet HR in Milan in December 2022 and identifies 2025 EUR 25m financing as Series A.

sources.title: Chiuso un nuovo round da 12 milioni di euro con Creandum
sources.evidence_paraphrase: EUR 12m Series A led by Creandum with Keen Venture Partners participating; footer distinguishes operating office Milan from registered office Agropoli.

sources.title: Sibill raises €12M Series A to modernise financial management for Italy’s SMEs
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Investor-hosted funding report states Sibill was founded in 2021 by Mattia Montepara, Lorenzo Liguori and Dario Prencipe.

sources.title: Tot secures €7 million to boost SMEs growth
sources.evidence_paraphrase: EUR 7m Pre-Series A led by CDP Venture Capital; named co-investors include The Techshop, Banca Sella, X-Equity Venture Club and Club Deal Digital. Ambiguous fund/adviser structure is clarified by CDP source.

sources.title: Tot: nuovo round d’investimento da 7 milioni di euro
sources.evidence_paraphrase: CDP invests via ServiceTech of Corporate Partners I. Describes Tot as Milan-based and names investor structures; FNDX acts through Azimut-promoted funds.

sources.title: Nasce Tot e ancor prima dell’ingresso sul mercato chiude un round da €2 milioni
sources.publisher: Tot company press release hosted by BeBeez
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Public company release announcing Tot formation and EUR 2m seed financing led by Banca Sella. Names founders Doris Messina, Bruno Reggiani and Andrea Susta. Product launch was planned for 2022, not a founding date.

sources.title: Tot — About
sources.evidence_paraphrase: Official platform and company identity; footer labels Tot S.p.A. and a Milan address without an explicit registered-office label.
